references.text: Matthew's parallel account of when they came down from the mountain after the transfiguration and were met by a crowd.
Mark's parallel account of when Jesus came down from the mountain after the transfiguration and a large crowd met them.
The preceding account of Jesus' transfiguration on the mountain, which is the background for why they now come down from the mountain the next day.
The following account of the man in the crowd who cries out to Jesus for help with his demon-possessed son—the event that takes place after Jesus meets the large crowd.
A similar situation where a crowd received Jesus, showing a recurring pattern in Luke of large crowds gathering around Jesus.
